subject: Dynamic-capacity tables
notes: kb/Work PB1042 (wave 1021 B2). §8.5.1.9.1 3): a dynamic-capacity table 'may be defined in any place, other than the file section, in which a fixed-capacity table may be defined and may be nested in any combination to the same number of levels as a fixed-capacity table'. The EXTERNAL / ADDRESS-OF half that DIVERGED (COBOL0899 'cannot be cell-backed') is closed: a cell-backed area's components (dynamic-length items and dynamic-capacity tables) ride managed slots of the cell, one ordinal per occurrence of every enclosing fixed table (Place.CellComponents; DataBinder.AssignCellComponents), and a table's slot is a CobolDynTable<StorageCell> whose occurrences are element cells, a scope of their own, so nesting in any combination is the same mechanism one level down. Measured: two programs sharing an EXTERNAL record see each other's growth (§13.18.22.4 GR1), group MOVE recreates (§14.6.9.2), INITIALIZE keeps the capacity (§14.9.20.4 GR10), SEARCH/SORT/SUM(ALL)/LENGTH/SET capacity work, a table nested in a table element and a dynamic-length item per occurrence run. The FILE SECTION bar stays (COBOL1526). Editions: 2014 introduced OCCURS DYNAMIC (COBOL0900 below it).
